text:
Ask every new customer one question: "How did you find us?"

Write the answers on the whiteboard in the shed. Keep it going for a month.

If a few say Google and you've never touched your Google profile, search is already bringing you work by accident.

Imagine what happens when you try.

Cold call: "We'll get you to number one on Google. Guaranteed."

Hang up. Then put the kettle on.

Google's own guide on hiring an SEO says nobody can guarantee a number one ranking. If someone does, find someone else.

Nobody outside Google controls Google.

Need the phone ringing by Friday? SEO is the wrong buy.

Run Google Ads first. Ads put you at the top of Google as soon as they're live.

SEO is for the business that can wait a few months for the map to start sending calls. Then the calls keep coming.

Most established businesses need both.
